main.description: Subscribe to a community to see its posts in your feed. Requires authentication.

community.description: Community identifier (DID, handle, name@origin, or bare local name) of the community to subscribe to

contentVisibility.description: Content visibility level (1=only best content, 5=all content)

uri.description: AT-URI of the created subscription record

cid.description: CID of the created subscription record

existing.description: True when the viewer already had a subscription record for the community (whether or not it was rewritten)

errors.name: Blocked
errors.description: Cannot subscribe - you are blocked from this community

errors.name: CommunityRemoved
errors.description: The community is removed by the instance and takes no new subscriptions
